raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.32.0"

package:
  name: httplib2
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/h/httplib2/httplib2-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 48a0ef30a42db65d8f3399045e1d09ab0ba66e3b9efc360d07f80ea55d286025

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=40.8.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pyparsing >=3.1,<4

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - httplib2
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  summary: A comprehensive HTTP client library.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/httplib2/httplib2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - sigmavirus24
